value: aliasResolved is captured differently in MCP vs CLI wrappers and has per-tool semantics the generic code does not handle. MCP wrapper (mcp-server.ts) auto-resolves via resolveKey(extractKey(params)) — works for most tools but extractKey's choice of which param is "the key" is tool-specific (e.g. reverie_copy returns params.dest ?? params.source, so aliasResolved tracks whether the dest was an alias, not the source — usually wrong for copy). CLI wrapper (instrumentation.ts) requires the callsite to pass both rawKey (original input) and key (resolveKey output); the check is rawKey && key && rawKey !== key. If a callsite pre-resolves and passes only key, aliasResolved is silently always undefined — the failure mode is invisible until a dataset needs the field. AUDIT COMPLETE (#119, 2026-06-09): confirm set/remove were the last droppers, fixed; remaining keyed callsites either pass rawKey or operate on alias names directly (no resolution). When ADDING a CLI callsite that calls resolveKey, pass rawKey too — nothing enforces it at compile time.
